gold.user: User wants to retrieve a list of all SIP Credential Lists associated with their Twilio account to manage their SIP configurations.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a JSON array of SIP Credential Lists, including details like SID, friendly name, and date created.

gold.user: User needs to create a new SIP Credential List to manage access for a new set of SIP endpoints.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating the creation of the SIP Credential List, including the new SID and confirmation message.

gold.user: User wants to fetch details of a specific SIP Credential List to review its configuration and credentials.

gold.user: User needs to update an existing SIP Credential List to add new credentials for additional SIP endpoints.
